_description: MIKA AGENTIC OS — Viral Content Workflow. Turns one approved content brief into staged, routed child tasks for the full content assembly line. Each stage is human-controlled: no stage executes without approval.
description: End-to-end content production pipeline from trend research to repurposing pack.

stages.outputExpected: 5-10 trending topics, viral patterns, platform-specific opportunities, sound/format recommendations
stages.notes: Hermes is the active fallback while Trend Hunter is staged. Hermes searches for trends manually.

stages.inputRequired: trend research output, platform, tone, audience
stages.outputExpected: 10 scroll-stopping hooks, A/B variants, pattern interrupts, curiosity-gap openers
stages.notes: Hook Engineer is staged. Hermes generates hooks from trend data and tone instructions.

stages.inputRequired: hooks, trend data, brand voice, content goal
stages.outputExpected: content angles, series concept, brand voice alignment, publishing cadence recommendation
stages.notes: Creative Director is staged. OpenClaw synthesizes strategy from hooks and trend data. Requires approval — strategy decisions affect multiple pieces.

stages.inputRequired: approved hook, content strategy, tone, audience, platform format
stages.outputExpected: full content script with opening hook, body, CTA — formatted for platform
stages.notes: Content Architect is staged. Hermes writes the full script using the approved hook and strategy.

stages.outputExpected: AI video/image generation prompts (Higgsfield/HeyGen/Veo-ready), visual direction brief
stages.notes: Prompt Engineer is staged. Hermes generates structured visual prompts. Video generation providers not yet connected.

stages.inputRequired: script, platform, content goal, primary offer
stages.outputExpected: platform-optimised caption, 3-5 hashtag sets, CTA variants, alt text if needed
stages.notes: Editor is staged. Hermes writes caption from script + goal. Caption routes as Script Creation.

stages.inputRequired: final script, caption, platform, other target platforms
stages.outputExpected: repurposed formats for all secondary platforms: thread, carousel outline, blog summary, pin copy, podcast segment
stages.notes: Content Architect is staged. Hermes repurposes the content across formats from the final script.
